description: Unified, provider-pluggable LLM interface for the red-team. Fleet seats resolve to Meta Muse Spark by default (REDTEAM_LLM_PROVIDER unset or =meta); the DeepSeek seat table in src/policy.ts is reached only by explicitly naming REDTEAM_LLM_PROVIDER=deepseek; Qwen (qwen3.8-max) registered, not routed.
name: @secscan/redteam-llm-router

scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.json && tsdown && node ../scripts/dist-hash.mjs write . lib
